reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Michigan
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate
    (i.e., notice to quit / notice terminating the tenancy) prior to terminating a tenancy?
*/

% ----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question's factual statement encoded)
% ----------------------------

state(michigan).
focus_year(2021).

landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).
tenancy(tenancy1).

% The question is general; we encode a minimal, typical termination scenario:
% - Landlord seeks to terminate an at-will tenancy
% - Rent is paid monthly (interval between payments = 30 days)
% - No nonpayment basis, no controlled-substance holdover basis
tenancy_type(tenancy1, estate_at_will).
rent_payment_interval_days(tenancy1, 30).

landlord_seeks_to_terminate(landlord1, tenancy1).
tenant_in_possession(tenant1, tenancy1).

% Facts indicating special statutory grounds are NOT present in this scenario.
tenant_neglects_or_refuses_to_pay_rent(tenancy1) :- fail.
tenant_holds_over_after_controlled_substance_clause_termination(tenancy1) :- fail.
formal_police_report_filed_controlled_substance(tenancy1) :- fail.

% Helper predicate summarizing the scenario in reusable logical form.
scenario_statement :-
    state(michigan),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(landlord1),
    tenant(tenant1),
    tenancy(tenancy1),
    tenant_in_possession(tenant1, tenancy1),
    landlord_seeks_to_terminate(landlord1, tenancy1),
    tenancy_type(tenancy1, estate_at_will),
    rent_payment_interval_days(tenancy1, 30).

% ----------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
% ----------------------------

/*
  MI Comp L  554.134(1) (2021)
  - Estate at will or by sufferance: may be terminated by either party by giving 1 month's notice.
  - If rent is payable at periods < 3 months, notice is sufficient if equal to the interval between payments.
*/
statute_554_134_1_notice_days_for_at_will_or_sufferance(Tenancy, Days) :-
    rent_payment_interval_days(Tenancy, IntervalDays),
    (   IntervalDays < 90
    ->  Days = IntervalDays
    ;   Days = 30
    ).

/*
  MI Comp L  554.134(2) (2021)
  - If tenant neglects or refuses to pay rent: landlord may terminate by giving written 7-day notice to quit.
*/
statute_554_134_2_notice(nonpayment_of_rent, 7, written_notice_to_quit).

/*
  MI Comp L  554.134(3) (2021)
  - Tenancy from year to year: may be terminated by either party by notice to quit.
  - Notice terminates lease at expiration of 1 year from service.
*/
statute_554_134_3_notice(tenancy_from_year_to_year, 365, notice_to_quit).

/*
  MI Comp L  554.134(4) (2021)
  - If tenant holds over after lease terminated under controlled-substance clause AND police report filed:
    landlord may terminate by giving written 24-hour notice to quit.
*/
statute_554_134_4_notice(controlled_substance_holdover_with_police_report, 1, written_notice_to_quit).

/*
  Combined rule for MI Comp L  554.134 (2021):
  Determine the applicable notice required to terminate the tenancy.

  This is written to be deterministic by ordering (most specific grounds first).
*/
statute_554_134_notice_required(Tenancy, Days, NoticeType, Ground) :-
    %  554.134(4)
    tenant_holds_over_after_controlled_substance_clause_termination(Tenancy),
    formal_police_report_filed_controlled_substance(Tenancy),
    statute_554_134_4_notice(Ground, Days, NoticeType),
    !.
statute_554_134_notice_required(Tenancy, Days, NoticeType, Ground) :-
    %  554.134(2)
    tenant_neglects_or_refuses_to_pay_rent(Tenancy),
    statute_554_134_2_notice(Ground, Days, NoticeType),
    !.
statute_554_134_notice_required(Tenancy, Days, NoticeType, Ground) :-
    %  554.134(3)
    tenancy_type(Tenancy, tenancy_from_year_to_year),
    statute_554_134_3_notice(Ground, Days, NoticeType),
    !.
statute_554_134_notice_required(Tenancy, Days, NoticeType, Ground) :-
    %  554.134(1)
    ( tenancy_type(Tenancy, estate_at_will)
    ; tenancy_type(Tenancy, estate_by_sufferance)
    ),
    statute_554_134_1_notice_days_for_at_will_or_sufferance(Tenancy, Days),
    NoticeType = notice_of_termination,
    Ground = at_will_or_sufferance,
    !.

/*
  MI Comp L  600.5716 (2021)
  - A demand for possession or payment shall be in writing, addressed to the person in possession,
    describe premises, state reasons and time to remedy; if nonpayment, state amount due; dated & signed.
  This can overlap with notices used in summary proceedings, but the core question here is notice to vacate.
*/
statute_600_5716_demand_requirements(
    writing_required,
    addressed_to_person_in_possession_required,
    premises_description_required,
    reasons_required,
    time_to_remedy_required,
    amount_due_if_nonpayment_required,
    dated_required,
    signed_by_entitled_person_or_agent_required
).

% ----------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% ----------------------------

% The law "requires notice prior to termination" if the landlord, to terminate, must give some notice
% under  554.134 that is greater than 0 days (including 24-hour notice modeled as 1 day).
landlord_must_give_notice_to_vacate_before_termination(Landlord, Tenant, Tenancy, Days, NoticeType, Ground) :-
    landlord_seeks_to_terminate(Landlord, Tenancy),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Tenancy),
    statute_554_134_notice_required(Tenancy, Days, NoticeType, Ground),
    Days > 0.

% ----------------------------
% Answer predicate (must be deterministic)
% ----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    landlord_must_give_notice_to_vacate_before_termination(landlord1, tenant1, tenancy1, _Days, _NoticeType, _Ground),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% ----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% ----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate the property prior to terminating a tenancy?
